review_protocol: Current reviewer independently opened CS001-CS015 at 8x-nearest and inspected every cell's ORIGINAL/TARGET OVERLAY/MASK ONLY triad; opened the listed 1x and 8x relation packages, the pre/opaque/final/XOR occlusion packages, low-profile samples, graphic masks, and the four required views. No historical FIG-P582-02 or FIG-P580 evidence was read.

glyph_mask_judgment.note: Per-cell manual result is recorded separately in the generated glyph ledger; font and strict category gates are deliberately not collapsed into this raw-mask decision.

relation_judgment.note: Opened all nine table-designated critical packages plus R0085 as an extra card/reference proximity package; each included original/A/B/intersection/overlay/8x-nearest evidence.

occlusion_judgment.note: Three required packages have covered-XOR=0 and show no hidden text loss.

font_visual_harmony.note: The 8.6pt tick labels and 9.2/9.4pt bar/card/annotation text look undersized beside the page body and the chart geometry. Stroke weight is restrained and internally coherent; blue/teal/gray encode roles coherently and remain distinguishable in grayscale. No scale reduction can repair this because the current effective sizes already violate the 9.5pt floor.

four_view_judgment.full_page_200dpi: Page fusion, reading order, and caption association are coherent; the undersized chart text remains visible but fails the explicit font-size gate.
four_view_judgment.figure_crop_300dpi: No visible collision, clipping, or unintended occlusion; small tick and annotation text is confirmed below the required size floor.
four_view_judgment.standalone_300dpi: Bar hierarchy, annotation card, reference line, and low bars are legible and uncrowded; size gate remains failed.
four_view_judgment.grayscale_300dpi: Hierarchy and reference-line contrast survive grayscale conversion; no extra visual defect, while the same size defect remains.

math_semantics.note: 0.90+0.05+0.03+0.02=1; reciprocal squared sum is 1/(0.81+0.0025+0.0009+0.0004)=1.2288..., correctly rounded to 1.23. The 1/4 reference and the reliability caveat agree with nearby text.

strict_classification_finding.note: The preliminary low-profile table improperly reduced '=' and '≈' below the 22px base-math/relationship gate and reduced CJK '一' below the 30px CJK gate. Low-profile punctuation lacks the required independent same-codepoint/font/size calibration closure.
